quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells drivers to take a different route because the normal road is blocked.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is joining the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and be ready to stop if other cars are coming.
Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
Go through carefully without always stopping.
Stop only if there is traffic on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when it is safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass. Then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road or driveway is not safe to enter from your direction. Turn around and find another way.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of people.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a certain number of people.
questions.explanation: This marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. It is reserved for buses and cars with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign tells you a detour is coming up in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs have black markings. This sign alerts you to an intersection coming up.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing the street. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: From top to bottom, what is the correct order of colors on a traffic light?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic light, red is always at the top and green at the bottom. On a horizontal traffic light, red is always on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that drivers from both directions can use the shared center lane only to turn left. Do not use the center lane as a regular driving lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to possible dangers ahead. This sign warns that traffic may enter from a side road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Be extra careful in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign do?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards on or near the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. This sign tells drivers that a lane is ending ahead. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. This sign shows either a school crossing or a school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What is the biggest danger when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work correctly because one side of your car is higher.
You could damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You could hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam on the brakes or steer sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at the intersection ahead and be ready to stop. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means you cannot do that action. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that a yield sign is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop to let other drivers and pedestrians go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians are walking on the road ahead.
Watch for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is coming. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is coming.
Look both ways before crossing the intersection.
Always stop completely at the intersection.
Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be ready to stop if needed.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign (with the arrow) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly cross or travel beside traffic here.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You can proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before going.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you pass this sign, you are going the wrong way. You risk a head-on crash. Carefully turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that deer may cross the road in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street from the wrong direction.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on green, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic light. It tells drivers that left-turning traffic does not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Yield on green when turning left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield on green when turning left.
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that when turning left at a green light, they must yield to oncoming traffic. Complete the turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic is coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
You can drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay on the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells drivers that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must stay to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A new lane is being added.

questions.correctAnswerText: A new lane is being added.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They get drivers ready for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts drivers that a new lane is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Traffic must move to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Traffic must move to the left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane on a multilane road will end. Cars in the right lane must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for drivers and workers. Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells you the right lane ahead will be closed because of construction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control how traffic moves and the rules drivers must follow. This sign means you cannot park here at any time.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves right, then curves left.
The road curves left, then curves right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then curves left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the road ahead will curve to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A regulation sign with a red circle and red slash means something is not allowed. Right turns are prohibited where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and honk your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn about hazards. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always yield to pedestrians in or entering a crosswalk. Stay alert for pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. They warn about hazards. This sign tells you a traffic light is coming. Get ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and workers. Orange signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you that construction is starting ahead. Drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign shows the direction you must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection is ahead. A road is joining from the right side.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand point straight up. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point straight up, they are signaling a right turn. If you see this signal, adjust your driving and expect the driver to turn right.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Divided highway starts. Slow down to 35 mph.
Merge ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown (35 mph).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Look carefully for traffic crossing from other directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the shoulder (edge of the road) is lower than the paved road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell drivers about hazards ahead. This sign warns drivers to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what should you do?

options.text: You can continue straight or exit from your current lane.
You can stay in your lane and continue straight.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You can either change lanes to continue straight or stay in your lane and exit.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules that drivers must follow. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is under construction.
The road ahead has loose gravel.
The road ahead has been sanded for icy conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead has loose gravel.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of hazards ahead. This sign tells drivers the road has loose gravel. Loose gravel reduces tire traction, so drivers should slow down.

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower if conditions are poor, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.
There is a stop sign ahead.
There is a caution sign ahead.
You must stop if other cars stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a stop sign ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and warn of hazards. This sign tells drivers a stop sign is coming so they can prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules drivers must follow. This sign tells drivers they can either turn right or continue straight from this lane at the intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves sharply right, then left.
The road curves sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show traffic rules drivers must follow. Where this sign is posted, U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones ahead. This sign tells you that the normal route is closed and you must follow a different path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a sharp right turn is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway entrance.
The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when exiting a highway. The number shown (like 30 mph) is the recommended speed for that exit.

questions.question: You see a "Merging traffic" sign on the freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When traffic is merging, make room by moving to another lane if it is safe to do so. This helps traffic flow smoothly.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or make U-turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass is coming with limited height. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you that a flagger (a person directing traffic) is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. You cannot go straight from this lane.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is always a stop sign. You must come to a complete stop, look for pedestrians and other traffic, and wait for it to be safe before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red light or yield to cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a four-way intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign is placed at traffic signals to show that you cannot turn right on a red light at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to upcoming hazards. This sign tells you to watch carefully and be prepared to stop because there may be a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead has one-way traffic only.
Only one car can cross the bridge at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that an upcoming bridge is narrow. You may not have enough space to safely pass or meet a truck, so drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that the road ahead is now divided by a median or divider. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to wait for the left turn signal to show it is safe to turn left.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main road if possible.
Follow the detour to the right only if convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Orange work area signs direct traffic around construction. A detour sign shows you an alternate route because the main road is blocked. You must follow the detour.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead. Watch for animals and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in the direction you are heading.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers how to follow traffic rules. You can park here for a maximum of two hours during the posted times.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that workers may be on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns of a steep hill coming up. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers traffic rules they must follow. It is posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this black and yellow sign mean?

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, there is a detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead will turn sharply in one direction. Slow down as much as you would for a turn at an intersection.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Should maintain your vehicle's speed until you enter the reduced speed zone.
Should begin to reduce your vehicle's speed.
Should not slow down because traffic will start to back up.
May reduce your speed, if you choose to do so.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should begin to reduce your vehicle's speed.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start slowing down your vehicle now. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign alerts you that the road ahead is being repaired or maintained. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about work zones. This sign tells you that traffic violations in this work zone will have double fines.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to road hazards. This sign tells you that lanes are moving or changing direction. Follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers traffic rules they must follow. It shows the slowest legal speed you can drive. Do not drive slower than this speed.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means "Yield." Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes very slippery when it rains or gets wet.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This circular sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go right or left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means trucks are not allowed in this area. Drivers must follow this rule.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign marks a reserved parking space for people with handicap permits or license plates. Only those vehicles may park here.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This eight-sided sign means you must stop completely. Let other traffic pass. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Merging traffic is approaching from the left.
Right lane ends ahead, merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Right lane ends ahead, merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end. Move to the left lane.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers that farm machinery may be in the area. Be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic only moves in the direction the arrow points.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs mean a school is nearby. Watch for children and pedestrians on or near the road. Follow any directions from a crossing guard.

questions.question: When you see a yield sign at an intersection, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield only to traffic on your right.
Yield only to traffic on your left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means slow down and let traffic in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a divided highway is coming. The road will split into two separate one-way roads with a median between them. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the fastest speed you are allowed to drive.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert you to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, reduce speed, avoid sudden braking or turning, and keep more distance between your vehicle and the one ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves right and then left. Slow down so you can safely drive through these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you not to block the intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign tells you to stay to the right to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers there are multiple lanes for turning left. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows drivers which direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic may merge from the right. Be ready to let it merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and prevent accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
Road turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Road turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.
